plan_needed: The Archie add-on (on Boost, Grow or Prosper+). Microsoft's Marketplace lists the add-in itself as free. Changes save back to Smokeball differently depending on your plan and whether you use Word desktop or Word on the web.

steps.do: Select Add-ins on the right-hand side of the Word ribbon, then select More add-ins and click the Store tab.
steps.see: The Microsoft add-in store.

steps.do: Search for "Archie" and install the Smokeball Archie add-in. If you can't find it, Smokeball's article links to the Microsoft Marketplace listing, where you click Get it now.
steps.see: The add-in installs.

steps.do: Select Add-ins again and click Smokeball Archie.
steps.see: The Archie panel opens on the right-hand side of Word.

steps.do: Log in with your Smokeball email, password and 2FA code when prompted.
steps.see: Archie connects to the matter automatically if the document came from Smokeball.

steps.do: For a document opened outside Smokeball, click Assign a matter to this document and choose the matter.
steps.see: Archie can now use that matter's details, documents and emails. Its edits appear as Word tracked changes for you to accept or reject.

from: Microsoft Outlook (new Outlook or Outlook on the web)
plan_needed: Smokeball Boost, Grow or Prosper+, and a paid Microsoft 365 Business or Education mailbox. Archie features need the Archie add-on. Personal Outlook.com, Hotmail and Gmail accounts aren't supported. If you see Admin approval required, your IT administrator must allow Outlook add-ins.

steps.where: Outlook on the web or the Outlook (new) app
steps.do: Select the Apps icon on the left panel, then select Add apps.
steps.see: The add-ins store.

steps.do: Search for Smokeball, click "Smokeball for Outlook" and select Add.
steps.see: The app is added.

steps.do: Select an email, click the Apps icon in the email and select Smokeball for Outlook.
steps.see: The Smokeball toolbar appears on the right.

steps.do: Confirm your Country and click Connect to Smokeball, then log in when the browser window opens. You may also be asked to log in to Microsoft to authorise the connection.
steps.see: The toolbar shows your most recently worked-on Smokeball matters. Select the Pin icon to keep it in view.

steps.do: With the Archie add-on, select Rapid Reply or Draft with Archie.
steps.see: AI-drafted text to review and edit before you send.

undo.do: Click Logout in the bottom corner of the toolbar.
undo.see: You can go back to the classic Outlook integration.

plan_needed: The Archie add-on. LawY, including Deep Research and lawyer verification, is included at no extra cost.

steps.where: Smokeball desktop app or web app
steps.do: Open a matter and select the Archie tab.
steps.see: The Archie screen.

steps.do: Select Legal Research in the top-left corner.
steps.see: The LawY chat box, set to the matter's practice area.

steps.do: Type your legal question.
steps.see: An answer with links to the resources LawY considered and suggested follow-up questions.

steps.do: To go further, select Deep Research + Human Verification, tick the questions, select relevant facts and choose Request Research.
steps.see: Deep Research takes about an hour. With verification, a qualified lawyer reviews it in about 1 to 3 business days. Smokeball says the verifier sees only the rephrased question, the AI answer and the facts you selected.

to: Archie access for one staff member
plan_needed: Firm Owner permissions. By default every user in the firm can use Archie.

steps.do: Select the Settings (gear) icon to open Smokeball Settings.
steps.see: Smokeball Settings.

steps.do: Select Staff & Users from the left menu, then select the Permissions button.
steps.see: The permissions grid. Only Firm Owners can open it.

steps.do: Select the user in the Name column and untick the Archie column.
steps.see: That user loses the Archie tab, the Archie matter widget and Archie settings.

steps.do: Select Save & Close.
steps.see: The change applies.

plan_needed: A Zapier account and a Smokeball login. Smokeball's support covers the integration working in Smokeball; questions about Zapier's own features go to Zapier.

steps.do: Log in and go to App Connections on the left menu.
steps.see: Your connected apps.

steps.do: Select Add connection, type Smokeball into the search field and select it.
steps.see: The Smokeball app.

steps.do: Select Add connection, confirm your region in the window that opens and log in with your Smokeball credentials.
steps.see: Smokeball is listed among your connected apps.

steps.do: Choose a Smokeball trigger event (for example New Matter) or add a Smokeball action event (for example Create Task), then test the step.
steps.see: A working Zap you can publish.

plan_needed: An AI Legal Assistant account (priced by that company) and a Smokeball login. Smokeball integrates with it but doesn't develop or manage it.

steps.do: Open AI Legal Assistant, select your profile picture in the top-right corner, then select Integrations.
steps.see: The list of integrations.

steps.do: Select Connect under Smokeball and log in with your Smokeball username and password.
steps.see: A Smokeball folder appears under Integrations on the AI Legal Assistant home page.

steps.do: Create a document as usual.
steps.see: A version of the document is saved to the Smokeball matter.

plan_needed: An AI Legal Toolbox account (pricing on its own website) and a Smokeball login. Support for the tool comes from AI Legal Toolbox.

steps.where: AI Legal Toolbox app in Outlook
steps.do: Log in, go to the Tools tab and select Connect Smokeball account.
steps.see: A sign-in window.

steps.do: Enter the email address and password you use for Smokeball, then select Sign in.
steps.see: The Tools tab shows Matters, Time, Contacts and History.

steps.do: Use Matters or Contacts to look up Smokeball records, or Time to create a time entry for a matter.
steps.see: The record or time entry in Smokeball. History shows linked emails and sync status.
